collection.title: Drop 001: Just hit a LiQ
collection.summary: Seven pieces, each numbered. Private early access before a public release.

products.title: Signature Heavyweight Hoodie
products.summary: 500 GSM washed-black fleece. The Q and its liquidity line over the heart, the full strike across the back.
products.description: From ten feet away it reads as a designer garment. From three feet you notice the chart language. If you trade, you understand it immediately. Wide and slightly cropped, with a structured drop shoulder and a double-layer hood with no drawcord.
details: 500 GSM cotton fleece, washed black
Wide, slightly cropped fit with a structured drop shoulder
Double-layer hood, no drawcord
Reinforced neckline and shoulder seams
Substantial ribbing at cuffs and hem
Chest: embroidered Q with the cobalt liquidity line
Back: JUST HIT A, the LiQ in high-density tonal print, cobalt level and price ladder; LIQUIDITY / SWEPT, NY SESSION, 09:42:17
Sleeve: LIQUIDITY. Cuff: the Q strike
Woven label: LiQ / DROP 001, garment number of 150

Bone.note: Proposed future edition: cream on cream

Espresso.note: Proposed future edition: espresso, stone, antique silver
